newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Bid for Great Central seen soon-analysts.
newsitem.headline: Bid for Great Central seen soon-analysts.

text.p: A possible takeover bid for Western Australian gold miner Great Central Mines Ltd by Canada's Barrick Gold Corp was likely to occur within the next few days, brokers and analysts said on Thursday.

A takeover bid for Great Central has been widely speculated in the market since Tuesday but both Great Central and Barrick have so far given no indication that an offer is on the table. "People are waiting for the bid. If it is going to happen it will happen within the next few days," said Peter Struk, a dealer at Sydney broker, Reynolds and Co.
